title: 第三十章 悟道台上，宿命对决
content_zh:
剑帝城，与其说是一座城池，不如说是一片被无上剑意切割、封印的破碎虚空。

    踏入城门的瞬间，林墨只觉天旋地转，周遭景象骤变。没有了蓝天白云，没有了赤红戈壁，取而代之的是一片灰蒙蒙的、仿佛混沌未开的空间。无数道颜色各异、强弱不一的剑意，如同流星般在这片空间中穿梭、碰撞，发出嗤嗤的破空声和金铁交击的轰鸣。一些地方，还能看到巨大的、仿佛被利剑斩开的虚空裂缝，以及漂浮在空中的、残破的宫殿楼阁碎片。

    空气中，弥漫着浓郁到几乎化为实质的剑意和一股古老、苍凉的气息。这里，仿佛就是剑道的坟场，也是剑道新生之地。

    进入剑帝城的修士，足有上千人。但此刻，所有人都被这片空间的浩瀚和神秘所震撼，纷纷停下脚步，小心翼翼地观察着周围的环境，不敢轻举妄动。

    林墨也站在原地，他闭上眼睛，将神识沉入意识海，感应着那枚剑帝令的指引。片刻后，他睁开眼，目光投向了这片破碎虚空的深处，一个特定的方向。

    “剑皇悟道台，在那个方向。”

    他没有丝毫犹豫，身形一动，如同游鱼般，在那些穿梭的剑意和破碎的空间碎片中，灵活地穿行，朝着目标方向快速前进。

    一路上，他看到了许多修士，有的在尝试收取那些漂浮的残破剑诀或古剑，有的则在与其他修士争夺某种机缘而大打出手，还有一些，则不小心触动了这片空间中隐藏的禁制，被瞬间爆发的恐怖剑意绞杀成渣。

    林墨无心他顾，他只想尽快赶到剑皇悟道台。他有一种预感，那里，不仅隐藏着关于“锈”和剑皇传承的最终秘密，也可能……与洛璃的苏醒有关。

    然而，就在他即将接近悟道台所在区域时，两道强大的气息，一左一右，如同两座大山般，拦住了他的去路。

    左边，是轩辕昊。他身穿金色龙袍，头戴紫金冠，负手而立，眼神睥睨地看着林墨，嘴角带着一丝玩味的笑容：“林墨？没想到，你真的敢来中州，还敢进入剑帝城。真是……天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你闯进来。”

    右边，是战无双。他身材魁梧，肌肉虬结，穿着一件暗金色的战甲，手持一柄沉重的青铜战戟，眼神如同野兽般，充满了侵略性和战意：“万道剑体？嘿嘿，听说你的体质很特殊，很适合做我的磨刀石！希望你不要让我失望！”

    显然，这两人，都通过各种手段，锁定了林墨的踪迹，专门在此等候！

    “让开。”林墨冷冷地看着两人，口中只吐出两个字。

    “让开？哈哈哈……”轩辕昊仿佛听到了天大的笑话，“林墨，你以为你是谁？在问道台上侥幸杀了我那个不成器的弟弟，就以为自己天下无敌了？今天，本皇子就让你知道，什么叫做真正的帝族底蕴！”

    他话音落下，不再废话，直接出手！他并指如剑，一道金色的、仿佛由皇道龙气凝聚而成的剑气，带着堂皇大势，如同一条金色神龙般，朝着林墨咆哮着冲来！

    这一剑，大气磅礴，堂堂正正，却蕴含着无坚不摧的威力！

    与此同时，战无双也动了！他没有任何花哨的动作，只是简简单单地，一戟刺出！这一戟，没有璀璨的光芒，没有惊人的声势，却仿佛凝聚了战族万古以来的杀伐之气，带着一种纯粹到极致的破坏力，直刺林墨的心脏！

    两大年轻至尊，一出手，便是绝杀！他们要速战速决，不给林墨任何喘息的机会！

    林墨眼神凝重。他知道，这两人，任何一个，实力都不在轩辕破之下，甚至犹有过之！两人联手，更是给他带来了巨大的压力！

    但他，没有退路！

    他深吸一口气，体内“无始皇道剑胎”疯狂旋转，一股包容万物、又斩断一切的独特剑意，冲天而起！
content_en:
Sword Emperor City is not so much a city as it is a broken void cut and sealed by the supreme sword intention.

    The moment he stepped into the city gate, Lin Mo felt that the world was spinning and the surrounding scene suddenly changed. There is no more blue sky and white clouds, no more red Gobi desert, instead there is a gray, as if chaotic, unopened space. Countless sword intentions of different colors and different strengths shuttled and collided in this space like meteors, making the sound of hissing through the air and the roar of gold and iron clashing. In some places, you can still see huge cracks in the void that seem to have been cut open by a sharp sword, as well as fragments of broken palaces and pavilions floating in the air.

    The air was filled with sword intent that was so rich that it almost turned into substance and an ancient, desolate atmosphere. This place seems to be the cemetery of kendo and the place where kendo is reborn.

    There are thousands of monks who entered Sword Emperor City. But at this moment, everyone was shocked by the vastness and mystery of this space. They stopped one after another and carefully observed the surrounding environment, not daring to act rashly.

    Lin Mo also stood there. He closed his eyes and sank his consciousness into the sea of ​​consciousness, sensing the guidance of the Sword Emperor Token. After a moment, he opened his eyes and looked into the depths of the broken void, in a specific direction.

    "The Sword Emperor Enlightenment Platform is in that direction."

    Without any hesitation, he moved his body like a fish, moving flexibly through the passing swords and broken space fragments, moving quickly towards the target direction.

    Along the way, he saw many monks. Some were trying to collect the floating broken sword arts or ancient swords, some were fighting with other monks for some kind of opportunity, and some accidentally touched the hidden restrictions in this space and were strangled to pieces by the terrifying sword intent that broke out in an instant.

    Lin Mo didn't care about him, he just wanted to get to the Sword Emperor Enlightenment Stage as soon as possible. He had a hunch that not only was the ultimate secret about "Rust" and the Sword Emperor's inheritance hidden there, but it might also... be related to Luo Li's awakening.

    However, just as he was about to approach the area where the Enlightenment Platform was located, two powerful auras, one on the left and one on the right, blocked his way like two mountains.

    On the left is Xuanyuan Hao. He was wearing a golden dragon robe and a purple gold crown on his head. He stood with his hands behind his back. He looked at Lin Mo with a stern look in his eyes and a playful smile on his lips: "Lin Mo? I didn't expect that you really dare to come to Zhongzhou and enter the Sword Emperor City. It's really... there is a way to heaven but you don't take it, and there is no door to hell but you break in."

    On the right is Zhan Wushuang. He is tall and muscular, wearing a dark golden battle armor and holding a heavy bronze halberd. His eyes are like a wild beast, full of aggression and fighting spirit: "Wandao sword body? Hehe, I heard that your physique is very special and is very suitable for being my whetstone! I hope you won't let me down!"

    Obviously, these two people have used various means to locate Lin Mo and are waiting here!

    "Get out of the way." Lin Mo looked at the two of them coldly and uttered only two words.

    "Get out of the way? Hahaha..." Xuanyuan Hao seemed to have heard a big joke, "Lin Mo, who do you think you are? You killed my incompetent brother by chance on the platform, and you think you are invincible? Today, this prince will let you know what the true imperial heritage is!"

    After he finished speaking, he stopped talking nonsense and took action directly! He pointed like a sword, and a golden sword energy, which seemed to be condensed from the imperial dragon energy, roared towards Lin Mo with a majestic momentum, like a golden dragon!

    This sword is majestic and dignified, but it contains invincible power!

    At the same time, Zhan Wushuang also moved! He didn't make any fancy moves, he simply thrust out with a halberd! This halberd had no dazzling light or astonishing momentum, but it seemed to have condensed the killing spirit of the War Clan for eternity. It pierced Lin Mo's heart with a pure and extreme destructive power!

    The two young supreme masters, once they take action, it is a sure kill! They must fight quickly and not give Lin Mo any chance to breathe!

    Lin Mo's eyes were solemn. He knew that the strength of any of these two people was not inferior to that of Xuanyuan Po, or even exceeded! The two of them joining forces put even greater pressure on him!

    But he has no way out!

    He took a deep breath, and the "Eternal Sword Embryo" in his body rotated crazily, and a unique sword intention that encompassed all things and cut everything rose into the sky!
title_en: Chapter 30: On the stage of enlightenment, a fateful showdown
